shots.displayName: 白底纸盒软管双件主图
shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用外盒加软管的完整到手形态建立合规主图。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, both units upright and fully inside frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left key with bounce fill, soft contact shadows
shots.props: outer carton beside the tube, nothing else
shots.whitespace: equal clean margins left and right, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product} with its outer carton standing next to the tube. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both units stand upright side by side in a straight-on eye-level view, carton on the left and tube on the right, fully inside the frame and never cropped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and a bounce card lifting the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding both units. Seamless #FFFFFF sweep background with no visible horizon. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame, centred with equal clean margins and no extra whitespace. Ultra-sharp commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props beyond the carton, no hands, no people, no watermark, no seals or badges, no rendered words or numbers, no floor mirror reflection, no cut-off edges, no tinted or gradient background.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：斜置产品加左列三行图标标题，一眼给出三条核心卖点。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 diagonal lean, product on the right third
shots.lighting: hard directional key from the upper left, crisp defined cast shadow, saturated colour punch
shots.background: flat #F4711E field with a lighter #F5842F plane corner
shots.props: three solid navy circular thin-line icons in a left column
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 45% for the icon and headline column
shots.textZone: left column, three stacked headline slots aligned to the icons
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The tube leans on its cap at a slight 3/4 diagonal on the right third of the frame, label fully facing camera. Background is a flat saturated #F4711E field with one lighter #F5842F plane corner behind the product, hard directional key from the upper left and a crisp defined cast shadow. Down the left column sit three solid #232C5C circles each holding one thin line icon, and beside them three short headline blocks reading 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」, 「{selling_point_3}」 in #232C5C. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space on the left 45% reserved for the icon and headline column. Negative: no more than three claims, no dense body text, no percentages or ingredient names, no professional or authority endorsements, no soft murky light, no duplicated icon shape, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands.

shots.intent: 用无身份的局部肤况特写放大粗糙堵塞的困扰，把观众带进问题现场。
shots.camera: side profile at skin level, extreme close-up of an isolated cheek and jaw crop
shots.lighting: flat cool top light with one harder side falloff, skimming light revealing surface texture
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen: an extreme close-up crop of cheek and jaw skin texture fills the left band, photographed in side profile at skin level and cropped well below the eye line and above the chin so no identity is readable, with skimming light from the left revealing rough congested surface texture. {product} stands on a matte pale board #EFE9E4 plinth on the right, upright and straight-on with the label square to camera. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat cool top light with one harder side falloff on the skin band, neutral 5600K. The product occupies 55-60% of the frame, tight framing with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable face, no eyes, nose or lips, no real person identity, no medical or clinical imagery, no wounds or exaggerated lesions, no plastic smoothed skin, no rendered words, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 保留双栏同光同框的分屏结构，让使用前后差异一眼可读。
shots.camera: square-on frontal view of two matched panels, identical crop both sides
shots.lighting: identical key direction and output on both panels, soft skimming light so only surface state differs
shots.background: deep #232C5C frame with a #2E7BC4 wave band along the bottom edge
shots.props: two blank rounded label plates and one blank headline band
shots.whitespace: wide navy margin across the top for the headline band, no extra whitespace elsewhere
shots.textZone: blank headline band on top plus two blank label plates under the panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen built as two matched square panels set inside a deep #232C5C frame, viewed square-on at eye level with identical camera height, identical crop and identical light on both sides. Both panels show the same abstract crop of cheek and jaw skin texture, cropped below the eye line so no identity is readable; only the surface state differs between the two panels, and a softer skimming light on the right panel reads calmer and more even. {product} stands upright on a small pale plinth #EFE9E4 centred on the seam between the two panels in the lower band, seen straight-on with the label square to camera, occupying 50-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A blank headline band sits across the top of the navy frame, two empty rounded label plates sit directly under the panels, and a lighter #2E7BC4 wave band runs along the bottom edge. Wide navy margin on top for the headline, no extra whitespace elsewhere. Negative: no dates, numbers, timeframes or percentages, no fabricated results, no two different people, no recognizable face, no mismatched lighting or crop between panels, no text inside the blank plates, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把产品放进淋浴间瓷砖现场，用清凉场景完成自我代入。

shots.lighting: hard direct daylight from the upper right, crisp short shadow to the left, 6000K
shots.background: glossy ceramic wall tile #8AD7EF with pale grout lines
shots.props: one mesh bath pouf in #F4711E behind the product
shots.whitespace: clean tiled negative space above and to the left of the tube, no other clutter
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing upright on a glossy tiled bathroom ledge, photographed from a low angle at ledge level with the tube turned a slight 3/4 toward camera. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright hard daylight from the upper right, 6000K, casting a crisp short shadow to the left and a small pool of reflected light on the tile. Background of large glossy ceramic wall tiles #8AD7EF with pale grout lines and a matching tiled ledge surface. Props: one mesh bath pouf in #F4711E resting behind the product, never covering the label. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with clean tiled negative space above and to the left and no other clutter. Negative: no people, no hands, no hair, no water droplets on the lens, no cluttered toiletries, no grime or mould in the grout, no warped tile lines, no floating product without contact shadow, no watermark, no fake logo, no rendered words.

shots.intent: 用四宫格加中心圆章同时演示面部与身体用法，扩宽适用人群。
shots.camera: square-on frontal grid, four equal quadrants, centre medallion overlay
shots.lighting: bright even studio light per quadrant, consistent direction, crisp contact shadows
shots.background: flat #F4711E panels with one pale skin-tone panel #EFE9E4
shots.props: blank solid navy circular medallion with a thin ring at the grid centre
shots.whitespace: grid fills the frame edge to edge, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce usage collage for {product}: a four-quadrant grid photographed square-on with four equal panels and a blank solid #232C5C circular medallion with a thin ring pinned at the exact centre of the grid, deliberately empty with no lettering inside it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top-left quadrant: a tight crop of a lathering cheek and jaw cropped below the eye line so no identity is readable, on a pale panel #EFE9E4. Top-right quadrant: {product} lying at a slight 3/4 diagonal on a flat saturated #F4711E field with a crisp cast shadow. Bottom-left quadrant: a tight zoom on a smear of airy pale foam #F5F5F2 on the same #F4711E field, skimmed by soft side light. Bottom-right quadrant: one hand working foam across a bare shoulder with the head out of frame. Bright even studio light with one consistent direction across all four panels and crisp contact shadows. Each quadrant holds its subject at 40-50% of its own panel, the grid filling the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable faces, no eyes or full lips, no deformed or extra fingers, no intimate areas, no lettering in the medallion, no mismatched lighting between quadrants, no duplicated product, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用膏体泡沫微距证明出质绵密，把清洁力转成可视化证据。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle, shallow depth of field, nearest bubbles sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the left revealing bubble walls, controlled highlights, no harsh speculars
shots.props: the dispensing nose of the tube just entering the upper edge
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a freshly dispensed dollop of airy pale foam #F5F5F2 squeezed from {product}, tight zoom on the bubble surface, photographed from a high 45-degree angle with shallow depth of field and the nearest bubbles tack sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft skimming light from the left revealing individual bubble walls and wet micro-highlights, no harsh speculars, neutral 5600K. Background is a smooth pale mist-blue surface #D9EDF5 rolling slightly darker toward the right, with the dispensing nose of the tube just entering the upper edge. The foam detail fills 55-60% of the frame, tight framing with no extra whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no uniform identical bubbles, no rainbow soap-bubble artefacts, no hair or lint in the foam, no hands smothering the detail, no invented ingredient visuals, no watermark, no fake logo, no rendered words.

shots.intent: 以平铺加留空凭证栏承接信任信息，供后端填入真实检测与配方资料。
shots.lighting: even high-key daylight from the top left, short crisp shadows, no dramatic falloff
shots.props: scattered foam dollops, four blank check rows and one empty seal outline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 40% for the blank credential stack
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen shot as a flat lay from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product} lies diagonally across a flat saturated #F4711E laminate, label facing up and fully readable, surrounded by a few scattered dollops of airy pale foam #F5F5F2 casting short soft shadows. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key daylight from the top left, neutral 5600K, no dramatic falloff. In the lower-left area sits a vertical stack of four empty rounded check rows in #FFFFFF plus one empty circular seal outline in #232C5C, deliberately blank so real documentation can be composited later. The flat-lay group occupies 35-40% of the frame overall, with generous negative space on the left 40% for the blank credential stack. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, test data, rankings, awards, years of heritage or free-from statements, no readable text inside the blank rows, no barcode or qr artwork, no duplicated product, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以三步导视把单品放进护理流程，做出连带选购与规格选择位。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on a three-unit arc
shots.lighting: strong directional daylight from the upper left, long hard-edged diagonal shadows, warm-neutral 5200K
shots.props: two blank unlabelled companion units and three curved navy arrows
shots.whitespace: clean margins along the top and bottom for the arrow labels, no extra clutter
shots.textZone: three short step labels along the arrow ends
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce regimen screen: {product} lies at a slight 3/4 angle on a matte light grey surface #EDEDEA beside two blank unlabelled companion units, one carton and one smaller tube, arranged in a gentle arc and photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Strong directional daylight from the upper left, 5200K, casting long hard-edged diagonal shadows across the surface. Three short curved single-weight line arrows in #232C5C sweep down toward each unit, each one finishing at a small label plate holding a single step word rendered as 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #232C5C. The group occupies 35-40% of the frame overall, with clean margins top and bottom for the arrow labels and no extra clutter. Negative: no brand marks or artwork on the companion units, no product name printed on them, no dense body text, no invented product types, no unit overlapping and hiding the main label, no warped shadow edges, no watermark, no fake logo, no duplicate of the hero product.

shots.lighting: high-key sunlight from the upper left, crisp clean shadow under the cap, cool 6200K

shots.props: one flat #F4711E offer strip band and one empty rounded button plate

shots.textZone: upper-left headline band plus bottom offer strip with one CTA plate

High-key sunlight from the upper left, 6200K, with a crisp clean shadow gathered under the cap and bright even falloff across the label. A flat #F4711E band runs across the very bottom edge as an offer strip holding one empty rounded button plate reading 「{callout_4}」 in #232C5C, and a wide blank headline band occupies the upper left. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：第1张白底纸盒与软管双件立姿主图；第2张纯橙底斜置软管加左列三行圆底细线图标与标题；第3张天蓝云层底、深青大标题带与底部橙色横条的背书排版；第4张深青框内双栏同框同光肤面特写、底部两个标签位与波浪色带；第5张橙色四宫格（面部起泡特写、产品斜置、泡沫色块、肩部涂抹）加中心圆形徽章；第6张橙色平铺俯视、软管斜置配泡沫色块与左下大字列表；第7张浅蓝瓷砖台面场景，硬光投影，橙色沐浴球道具；第8张浅灰平铺三件搭配、三条手绘弧线指向三个步骤词。品类判定依据：图为软管装面部与身体通用的清洁类洁面产品，属清洁护理而非着色彩妆，故判护肤个护/面部护理（与身体清洁/美妆彩妆均相邻但取其主用途洁面）；主产品唯一、非色卡变体画廊、非混合套装，仅第8张含搭配连带件，故按单主产品转化。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、原图全部英文文案与原句、成分百分比与配方强度字样、专业机构推荐与排名类主张、奖项与社会证明类字样、圆形徽章与序号印章内容、净含量数字、平台角标；第4张痘痘前后对比仅保留双栏同框分屏结构，两侧具体主张与人物身份全部剥离，肤面一律写作无身份局部特写；数值与资质位改为空白凭证栏、空标签牌与空按钮位。
